main_text.l: in perpetuum opem nobis denegaturum, duodecim sunt in die horae, quâ autem horâ, Dominus velit operari nescimus; Perge itaq; , Vir Colende, eo quo coepisti modo, cum Serenissima Domina tua Principe Wirtembergica Conjugativam tuam Artem mirabilem, mihi gratissimam, nunquam satis legi, speramus etiam quod brevi eius copiam publico fis concessurus. Interim vale, Vir Colende, cum Rev. D. T. Colleg. Domino Mimardo, uti & Domino de Blair, unà cum Spectatissimis Dominis vestris Diaconis & Senioribus, Fratribus charissimis, vos omnes & singulos, Deo, precibus meis, meipsum, & illi, & vobis, iugiter commendo. Dab. Prati puri; Calend. Maiis. Anno Christi 1662.

page.notes: The ornamental headpiece at the top is not text. The left edge strip shows fragments of the neighbouring page and was left out. The signature "A 3" is read from a small, worn mark and is doubtful. Long s is written as plain s throughout, and "fis" is transcribed as printed. The closing lines "V. R. D." and "Cultor Perpetuus S. W." are right-set in the print and are given as paragraphs.
